name: okf
description: Create, update, validate, refresh, share, and (optionally) passively capture Open Knowledge Format v0.2 bundles.

interface.shortDescription: Create, maintain, refresh, and share OKF v0.2 bundles.
interface.longDescription: Create, update, validate, refresh (anti-staleness), and share source-agnostic Open Knowledge Format v0.2 knowledge bundles, with optional passive capture. Hooks are Claude Code only.
defaultPrompt: Create an OKF v0.2 bundle from these sources.
Refresh the stale concepts in this OKF bundle.
Export this OKF bundle as a shareable viz.html and archive.
